preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n-1 for n, edges in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+n+1] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]])]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n for x, y in [line.split() for line in edges]) for n, edges in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]], [stdin.splitlines()[i+2:i+n+1] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]])]))
preconditions.description: Each edge in a test case connects two vertices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output.splitlines()[i]) <= n for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a nonnegative integer not exceeding n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output.splitlines()[i]) == 0 if n == 1 else True for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]]))
postconditions.description: If there is only one vertex, the output is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output.splitlines()[i]) == 1 if n == 2 else True for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]]))
postconditions.description: If there are two vertices, the output is 1.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output.splitlines()[i]) == 2 if n > 2 else True for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::n+1]]))
postconditions.description: If there are more than two vertices, the output is 2.
